title: Minute metering from provider records, prepaid debits with markup, fraud limits (G1)
goal: Charge agencies for calls from what the provider actually billed, stop calls when the balance is empty, and block the usual telephone fraud patterns.
why: ADR-001 section 7: minutes are counted only when an agent saves an outcome (routes/calls.ts ~411-423) and the cap is never checked; no prepaid check, country allow-list, premium-prefix block, rate limits, maximum call length or spend alerts.
blockedOnOwner: G1 (ADR-001 Addendum A: Twilio outside India, agency-owned Exotel in India)
steps: Master 0024: call_rates (country, destination_type mobile|landline|inbound|number, retail_per_min REAL, currency, active) seeded from COST-MODEL 6.2 as inactive until the owner approves; call_usage (tenant_id, provider_call_id UNIQUE, direction, destination_country, billed_seconds, provider_cost REAL, retail_amount REAL, wallet_entry_id, recorded_at).

metering.ts: every 5 minutes per tenant (tenant jobs queue) fetchUsage since the last cursor, price each record at retail (per started minute), debit the wallet with idempotency key `call:<providerCallId>`, store call_usage; an inbound overdraft limit per agency (setting, default ₹100 / $2).

fraud.ts preflight on POST /calls/outbound: balance > 0 (inbound exempt within overdraft), destination country in the agency allow-list (default own country; platform toggles others), premium/satellite prefixes blocked (static prefix list), per-agent 10 calls/min and 3 concurrent, per-agency daily spend cap (setting) and max call length (2 h via provider time limit); refuse with clear codes; never cut a live call.
Spend alerts: daily spend > 3x the 14-day average or > platform daily ceiling -> email to the platform owner and a super admin dashboard flag.
tests: backend/test/voip-metering.test.ts: fixture usage records debit once each (replay safe); zero balance blocks outbound with BALANCE_EMPTY; premium prefix blocked; country outside allow-list blocked; 11th call in a minute blocked; spend spike raises an alert.
acceptance: Billing uses provider records only (code review + tests).
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
goLiveVerify: Owner-approved retail rates (G1 item 6); provider-side geo permissions configured to match; spend triggers at the provider if available.
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.

Read docs/decisions/ADR-001-voip.md (sections 4, 6, 7) and docs/CALL-AUTOMATION.md (sections 2, 3, 4) before editing; they are the specification. G1 (provider choice and India shape) is not signed: everything here stays behind the VoipProvider interface.
ownerDecisionNote: Plivo dropped on 2026-10-14 (owner could not sign up). Target Twilio.
